title: gnaphalium demidium
intro: Gnaphalium demidium, commonly known as Snowy Cotton-Top or False Everlasting, is a plant species in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium demidium include wound healing, anti-hemorrhagic, and antiseptic activities, making it a potential remedy for skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
